features: A fresh design: calmer colours, a new typeface, and light and dark themes that both look their best.
A Devices screen showing every device that shares your clipboard and when it last sent something.
Search your clips and filter them by text, links or images.
A new update card that slides in on every screen, on Mac, Windows and Android, with download progress right in the card.
improvements: Clips are grouped by day, and images show large enough to recognise at a glance.
Adding a device is one sheet: scan the QR code or copy the key.
Pairing is simpler, with the key, a new-key button and the scanner in one place.
Better text contrast throughout, in both themes.
fixes: Update notices now appear when you come back to Clippy. Before, the app checked only when it first started, which on a phone or a tray app could be days ago.
